features.pageSubtitle: What FarmManager delivers for multi-tenant farm operations.
features.heroSubtitle: Real capabilities of the multi-tenant farm SaaS — not a mock roadmap. Built for owners, managers, workers, and the platform SuperAdmin.

multiTenant.title: Multi-tenant farms
multiTenant.text: Each registered farm is an isolated tenant. All data is scoped by farm_id so one farm never sees another's livestock, finances, or tasks.

rbac.title: Role-based access (RBAC)
rbac.text: SuperAdmin, Owner, Manager, and Worker each get permissions and UI tailored to their job — no shared admin clutter.

tasks.title: Task verification & rating
tasks.text: Full lifecycle: PENDING → IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETED → APPROVED or REJECTED, with 1–5 star ratings and owner feedback.

livestock.title: Livestock & crops
livestock.text: Track animals by tag and health status. Manage fields by crop type, area in hectares, and planting dates.

finances.title: Finances & salaries
finances.text: Owner-only income/expense ledger. Set employee wages; workers can view only their own salary privately.

vacations.title: Vacation requests
vacations.text: Workers request annual, medical, personal, or unpaid leave. Owner and Manager approve or reject with feedback.

jwt.title: JWT authentication
jwt.text: Secure SPA login with SimpleJWT. Suspended farms are blocked at token issue and on every API call.

admin.title: Platform admin & pricing
admin.text: SuperAdmin sees global metrics, suspends tenants, and assigns subscription plans (Free, Basic, Pro, Enterprise).
